CssFunction = object
  fname*: string
Payload for CSS function values (translate3d, blur, gradients, ...). The full canonical spelling lives on the foreign tag (used by valueToCssText); the payload keeps the function name for introspection. One payload type serves all function families; the family is carried by the value's TypeKind (ttyTransform, ttyFilter, ttyImage, ttyShape, ttyEasing, ttyColor).
